subject: Virtual Coffee - road safety
text:
Hi [NAME],

I met Mengliao Wang at the Ray Summit - it sounds like building
vision-based model is a key focus for your team, much like our customer
Motive. So I wanted to reach out for a virtual coffee.

For context - we help Motive improve annotation quality with automated
pipelines. On Encord, technical teams curate and filter million miles of
driving videos according to model failure modes, where they send directly
to annotation team to validate and adjust labels.

Keen to hear where you see [COMPANY]'s data preparation workflow to be
improved. Would you be open to a virtual coffee afternoon times tomorrow?
